author: Baila Eve Zisman
title: Howie Mandel Apologizes To Kelly Ripa - And Declares He Looks Great For His Age - NewsBreak
text:
By Baila Eve Zisman ,
11 hours ago Howie Mandel has publicly apologized to Kelly Ripa after a tense moment on a recent episode of Live with Kelly and Mark .
Mandel, 70, appeared on the March 23 episode of Live with Kelly and Mark , in which Ripa’s husband and co-host, Mark Consuelos, told Mandel he looked “great.” Mandel responded by declaring that when someone tells a person of his age they “look great,” that doesn’t “mean anything,” given that it contains the “caveat” that the person only looks good for their age.
Mandel compared it to telling someone, “You’re smart for a stupid person.”
At the time, Ripa had attempted to clarify, “We’re not saying you look great for 70. We’re saying you look great — and I don’t believe you’re 70.”
Although a source close to the situation told Entertainment Weekly the exchange was meant merely “casual banter,” the internet quickly began to construct versions of the story that saw Ripa genuinely upset by the interaction.
On Saturday, Mandel posted a video on Instagram, captioned “Message to @kellyripa.”
Subscribe To Our Cheat Sheet!One week of pop culture news in your inbox! He began, “I have been debating for 48 hours whether I should make this post or not. And I don’t know if I’m doing the right thing, philosophically…”
“I don’t believe that somebody… who’s a comedian needs to apologize for a joke. It is a joke. It is meant as a joke, and it’s not meant to offend,” Mandel stated. “In all my years, 50 years in the business, I haven’t ever publicly kind of apologized for [a joke]. It’s hard for me.”
He continued, “But this is for Kelly Ripa, who, in the past, has been incredibly supportive. Not only have I been a guest on her show, but I have co-hosted with her, and I’ve known her for years… When I go out there, I just try to be entertaining and funny, and sometimes, as a comedian, things don’t land the way you mean them to land.”
Mandel said, “And I don’t know how to say this, but not only do I want to say I’m sorry to Kelly, but — and this is the hardest part — you’re right. You’re absolutely right. And I’m sorry I didn’t see it that way.”
“After a lot of thought and self-reflection, I do look great for my age! I really do,” Mandel said, smiling. “I look fantastic, and I just have to embrace the fact that I look this good.”
